subject: Mathematics
overall_notes: Round 2 retrofit fully landed. Friel, Curcio & Bright (2001) cited by name in expanded_walkthrough.rationale with the reading-the-data / reading-between-the-data / reading-beyond-the-data framework, and re-cited in action step 6 anchoring the STRATEGY COMPARE move. Three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A names tallest without counting; B off-by-one height read; C cannot connect bar to category) each give a substitute teacher a concrete branch. Detective Dot's bar-graph refrain ('Bar height equals — the COUNT! Title, labels, axes — case CLEAR!') is quoted in the hook and chanted back in the consolidation exit_routine — memorable and quotable. STRATEGY COMPARE step has two pairs share bar graphs of the same two-way table and class compares same-data/same-heights/swapped-rows-and-columns — invents and refines, then compares strategies, exactly the Level 4 mathematical_authenticity move. Materials are everyday (anchor chart, grid, tally data, tracker); puppets explicitly OPTIONAL with three substitutions named; movement-learner differentiation provides the no-paper 'living bar graph' alternative. Worksheet Part 3 is a transfer task (novel survey), not a rote repeat of Part 2. Lesson-worksheet mapping is tight: P1→read, P2→build from tally with title and labels, P3→survey-and-build. All six categories at 4.
